en: Vintage monochrome postcard with an Art Nouveau style border framing a coastal scene. The image shows a wide sandy beach with scattered people and beach debris in the foreground, a tree‑covered dune or hill running along the shoreline, and a pavilion‑like building with towers among trees on the right. Printed captions in Russian and German appear beneath the image.
